cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: You Could at Least…
cards.instruction: Make the inconvenience visible enough that an apology becomes the easiest way forward.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your spill soaked my sock. I've laid it beside your plate so we can assess the damage properly.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That identifies the liquid, not the inconvenience. Please compare it with my dry sock before dismissing the result.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I understand. Can you take them off the dinner table?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: An acknowledgement is not an apology. Say you're sorry and I'll clear both samples. Then we can eat.
